description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Empowered Autogenerator and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Empowered Autogenerator and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Empowered Autogenerator and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Empowered Autogenerator
uses.cardState: with X or more charge counters on it
